independentAssessment.statement: Full exact pinned description/input/output/notes read; all samples match. Original flattened HTML retained separately. Only the two declared exponent spans changed. Fresh public English GET independently matches attested input/output DOM and literal superscripts: k and string length 10^6.
independentAssessment.officialRole: 31 of 82 advertised official pairs are available and preserved exactly as supplementary, NOT a complete official suite. All 9 advertised upstream-generated pairs are present; qualification is extensive generated basis.
independentAssessment.generatedDiversity: All 158 authored inputs are distinct; two fresh offline seeded generator runs reproduce both exact pair bytes and recorded output hashes. Independent reviewer derives every supplied answer without trusting generator output or worker recipe.
independentAssessment.derivation: For k>0, each block of k consecutive ones admits starts after the preceding one through the first one, and ends from its last one through before the next one: multiply those gap lengths and sum. For k=0, sum z*(z+1)//2 for maximal zero runs. This is distinct from worker prefix-frequency counting.
independentAssessment.bruteCrossCheck: Exact enumeration of all substrings for every binary string of lengths 1..10, and k=0..length+1: 22526 independent comparisons.
independentAssessment.sampleMeanings: For k=1,s=1010, six position-distinct substrings contain one one; k=2,s=01010 has four; k=100 gives zero.
independentAssessment.coverage: 0041..0044 cover minimum length, k=0, one required one, and impossible excess k; 0045 covers triangular zero runs, 0046 long start/end gaps. 0047 has k=1000000 and one million ones, answer1; 0048 has one million zeros, answer500000500000, covering maximum length and 64-bit count. All 150 named fixed-seed adversarial cases and every supplementary pair independently solved.
independentAssessment.authenticity: Ten counted sources have distinct IDs and source hashes; each exact public pinned TESTS row, programming language and expected verdict is authenticated. The sixth accepted public oracle is disjoint from all ten counted references by both ID and source hash. These are dataset compatibility-adjusted bytes, not a claim of original live Codeforces source bytes.

87062593.reason: Overwrites res at each endpoint instead of summing, and omits the empty-prefix frequency. The independent LF witness k=0,s=0 returns 0 instead of 1. First recorded test 0001 additionally fails numerically.

95409206.reason: Builds frequencies for all prefixes before evaluating endpoints, thereby counting future/self prefixes when k=0. LF k=0,s=0 returns 2 rather than 1, and k=0,s=1 returns 1 rather than 0. This intrinsic numeric error, not its first CRLF test failure alone, qualifies.

112024794.reason: Uses powers of two instead of gap products, an invalid trailing sentinel, and a premature constant return. LF k=0,s=1 returns 1 instead of 0; LF k=1,s=0010001000 returns 36 instead of 28. Runtime failures on other cases are not the basis of qualification.

115386306.reason: Omits the final one-only substring boundary and multiplies by the left-start gap twice in final accumulation. LF k=1,s=1 returns 0 instead of 1; k=1,s=0010001000 returns 60 instead of 28.

120237141.reason: Does not read the requested k or binary string: computes only the fixed instance k=1,s=1010 and always prints 6. This is a constant-instance solution, not a correct input-dependent solution with debug output or whitespace trouble. Actual input k=0,s=0 needs 1; k=0,s=1 needs 0; both receive 6. First recorded 0002 needs 4 and receives 6. Public source is unchanged, authenticated, and the numeric LF defect is reproduced.
